question: With what offerings and at which locations should worship be performed?
premises: Worship occurs in various specific places.
Worship is directed to the limbs of the goddess.
Flowers anointed with scented water are used.
inference: Worship should be performed on the limbs of the goddess in their respective places using flowers anointed with scented water.
plain_english: In those various places, on the limbs of the goddess, one should worship with flowers anointed with scented water.
